'''Eli Barkai''' ([[Hebrew language|Hebrew]]: אלי ברקאי) is a professor of physics at [[Bar-Ilan University]], located in [[Ramat-Gan]], Israel.<ref name="cv"/>

==Education==
Barkai studied physics in [[Tel Aviv University]], completing his Ph.D. in 1998. He then joined Bob Silbey at [[MIT]] for his post-doctoral studies. In 2002 he joined the faculty of [[Notre Dame University]] and in 2004 returned to Israel to Bar Ilan University where he became a full professor in 2010.<ref name="cv"/>

==Research==
His main research is in the field of non-equilibrium [[statistical mechanics]]. In particular he helped develop the theory of
[[fractional calculus|fractional]] kinetic equations for anomalous [[diffusion]] and relaxation, theory of single molecule [[spectroscopy]], and weak [[ergodicity]] breaking.
Among the physical systems he studied are  blinking of quantum dots, the diffusion of cold atoms in atomic traps and the diffusion of single molecules within a live cell.

==Honors and awards==
Barkai has received several prizes: the Krill prize (2006, selected by the Wolf foundation),<ref>{{Cite web|date=2020-01-07|title=Eli Barkai|url=https://wolffund.org.il/2020/01/07/eli-barkai/|access-date=2021-03-28|website=Wolf Foundation|language=en-US|archive-date=2021-04-22|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210422174116/https://wolffund.org.il/2020/01/07/eli-barkai/|url-status=dead}}</ref> the Michael Bruno Memorial award (2009, selected by Yad Hanadiv)<ref>{{Cite web|title=Bruno Laureates|url=https://iias.huji.ac.il/brunolaureates|access-date=2021-03-28|website=iias.huji.ac.il|language=en}}</ref> and the Friedrich Wilhelm Bessel Research award (2011, selected by the Alexander von Humboldt foundation).<ref name="cv"/>

==Family==
Married to Adina Alster, daughter of [[Jonas Alster]].{{citation needed|date=March 2021}} Barkai has three children<ref name="cv">{{Cite web|last=Eli|first=Barkai|title=Curriculum Vitae|url=https://faculty.biu.ac.il/~barkaie/AmEli.pdf|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120505131804/http://faculty.biu.ac.il/~barkaie/AmEli.pdf |archive-date=2012-05-05 }}</ref>
